mapper.sql: select a.*, c.status category_status, w.wbs_code work_package_code, w.wbs_name work_package_name, w.status work_package_status from pm_project_actual_cost a left join pm_cost_category c on c.cost_category_id=a.cost_category_id left join pm_project_wbs_node w on w.wbs_id=a.work_package_id
mapper.select: where a.project_id=#{projectId} order by a.occur_date desc,a.actual_cost_id desc
mapper.update: update pm_project_actual_cost set work_package_id=#{workPackageId}, actual_amount=#{actualAmount}, occur_date=#{occurDate}, description=#{description}, correction_no=correction_no+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where actual_cost_id=#{actualCostId}

update pm_project_actual_cost set cost_status='REVERSED', reverse_reason=#{reason}, reversed_by=#{operator}, reversed_time=sysdate(), update_by=#{operator}, update_time=sysdate() where source_type=#{sourceType} and source_line_id=#{sourceLineId} and cost_status='EFFECTIVE'
mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_project_actual_cost where cost_category_id=#{costCategoryId}
select coalesce(sum(actual_amount),0) from pm_project_actual_cost where project_id=#{projectId} and cost_status='EFFECTIVE'
select coalesce(sum(actual_amount),0) from pm_project_actual_cost where project_id=#{projectId} and cost_category_id=#{costCategoryId} and cost_status='EFFECTIVE'
select coalesce(sum(actual_amount),0) from pm_project_actual_cost where project_id=#{projectId} and work_package_id=#{workPackageId} and cost_category_id=#{costCategoryId} and cost_status='EFFECTIVE'
select cost_category_id, null work_package_id, sum(actual_amount) actual_amount from pm_project_actual_cost where project_id=#{projectId} and cost_status='EFFECTIVE' group by cost_category_id

select work_package_id, cost_category_id, sum(actual_amount) actual_amount from pm_project_actual_cost where project_id=#{projectId} and work_package_id is not null and cost_status='EFFECTIVE' group by work_package_id,cost_category_id
